verdict.rationale: Data retention and deletion is a fair question for a stateful agent framework that persists checkpoints and long-term stores. The evidence documents only that data is persisted (checkpointers, stores, a Postgres-backed checkpointer, Threads/Store API endpoints). Nothing in the pack documents retention policies, TTLs or deletion of threads, checkpoints or store items. Choosing your own database backend is a user-side arrangement, not a retention or deletion control.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can control data retention and deletion
